description: This file defines an abstract class for a command strategy that checks HTTP conditional headers, particularly ETag headers, against an entity in a system that seems to involve versioning and concurrency control. It is part of a utility package for persistent actors within the Eclipse Ditto project and handles validation of headers like If-Match and If-None-Match for command processing.

classes.name: AbstractConditionHeaderCheckingCommandStrategy
classes.description: An abstract class implementing command strategies that validate HTTP conditional headers, especially ETag headers, for entities and commands within the Eclipse Ditto system. It ensures that preconditions based on entity versions are met before executing the command logic.

methods.name: AbstractConditionHeaderCheckingCommandStrategy
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the strategy with the class of commands it handles.

methods.name: getValidator
methods.description: Abstract method to retrieve the ConditionalHeadersValidator used for header validation.

methods.name: apply
methods.description: Performs conditional header checks on the entity and command being processed. Returns error results if preconditions are not met, otherwise proceeds with the superclass apply method.

methods.name: isDefined
methods.description: Checks whether the command's entity ID matches the entity in context, indicating if the strategy is applicable.
